answer: Proof of Stake creates a velvet barrier against Sybil attacks by tying voting power to capital, forcing an attacker to acquire a majority of total network assets to influence consensus. Like a rising tide that renders individual identity fraud futile, this model requires the attacker to bear the heavy falcon cost of purchasing and locking massive liquidity. Without capital, agents cannot scale their influence, effectively neutralizing low-cost identity replication within the decentralized economy.
